summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 728 KB payload
details: The package's package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13) and invokes it via execFileSync to run the sibling file math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a ~728 KB bun-compiled bundle (// @bun @bun-cjs) with hex-mangled identifiers (MmgoCP, etDiOOB, WV8StW), a large rotated numeric string array, and a string-array decoder — an obfuscator.io-style layout unrelated to the package's advertised OpenFeature/LaunchDarkly feature-flag SDK wrapper purpose. The package is published under the @servicetitan scope with an empty author field and no repository metadata; the shipped preinstall dropper and obfuscated payload do not match the advertised SDK purpose. Installing this package causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code to execute on the installer's machine under a second runtime that bypasses Node-based scanning, before any application code is imported.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
